metadata.purpose: Designed to support GDPR Article 6 (lawful basis), Article 17 (right to erasure), and Article 30 (records of processing) workflows. Not a compliance attestation. Verdifax provides the policy mechanism; the customer's Data Protection Officer attests compliance for their use case.
metadata.intended_audience: EU-based data controllers and processors using Verdifax to seal attested decisions involving personal data of EU data subjects.
metadata.what_this_does: Refuses admission when the caller fails to declare actor identity, supervisory authorization, model provenance, decision classification, or the GDPR lawful basis for processing. Combined with Verdifax's CRES Phase-1 erasure capability, supports the Article 17 right-to-erasure workflow with sealed DeletionReceipts.
metadata.what_this_does_not_do: This profile is NOT a GDPR compliance certification. GDPR compliance requires documented data-protection impact assessments (DPIAs), data subject access request (DSAR) procedures, breach-notification workflows, lawful basis documentation, and ongoing DPO oversight outside Verdifax's scope.
